items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: Nevertheless the second year I remember calling Doc Cheatham was a — one of the three kings.

ctx.x: Yes right. There is a limit to that. But I envision the whole idea and then approaching these musicians and you did well.

Well it’s very funny because that first year nobody knew what it was you know. I mean I got — the very first year I did it I had Grady Tate, Tommy Flanagan, George Mraz — but a good band and so forth. And they all did it. The second year there’s a whole story in between that that you don’t want to hear. Nevertheless the second year I remember calling Doc Cheatham was a — one of the three kings.
